notes.title: Small Bug fixes + Sweet details added
notes.content:
This update contains:

Small Bug Fixes:
 
- Volume controls now working fine
- Issues on taking pieces in the Bonus levels now vanished. 

Simple Art details added:

- Sweet LIS like wind lines animations as you can see here
- Nice elements on menu backgrounds. 

Everything for you to play better, and feel better. I really hope you enjoy!

Rafael Almeida.
